description: Operations extraction from saas-startup-team (#629); baselines and ratchets measured at saas-operations 1.0.0 extraction.

total_md_sh_excl_tests_docs.baseline_note: Clean git tree at the #629 saas-operations 1.0.0 extraction.

total_md_sh_excl_tests_docs.notes: Only plugin-root tests/ and docs/ are excluded as directories. Nested trees (e.g. skills/*/tests) remain in the total so tests cannot hide runtime surface by relocation. Root CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md are harness local files and are not plugin runtime surface.

counting_rules.line_count: wc -l semantics: count newline bytes per regular file (no symlink follow)
counting_rules.scripts_sh_loc: Sum LOC of all regular files matching scripts/**/*.sh
counting_rules.wrapper_skills_hand_maintained: Count of directories skills/saas-operations-*-workflow whose SKILL.md lacks both the GENERATED-ALIAS: do not edit marker and the repo-sync marker: This generated skill is the Codex-native plugin surface for
counting_rules.wrapper_skills_hand_maintained_loc: Sum LOC of SKILL.md in hand-maintained skills/saas-operations-*-workflow directories (neither GENERATED-ALIAS: do not edit nor the repo-sync marker: This generated skill is the Codex-native plugin surface for)
counting_rules.agents_md_loc: Sum LOC of all regular files matching agents/**/*.md
counting_rules.runtime_prompt_surface_loc: Sum LOC of all regular *.md under agents/, commands/, and skills/ (includes skill references and wrapper SKILL.md)
counting_rules.total_md_sh_excl_tests_docs: Sum LOC of all regular *.md and *.sh under the plugin root, excluding only top-level tests/ and docs/, and root CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md (harness local files)
counting_rules.wrapper_namespace: Wrapper prefix follows plugin; repo-sync generated Codex workflows are generated aliases and still count toward runtime/total LOC.

counting_rules_allow_change.notes: The #629 extraction uses the saas-operations wrapper namespace; hand-maintained metrics exclude GENERATED-ALIAS and repo-sync generated workflows.

generated_files.notes: Generated prompt/script output under the plugin root is counted. Generation is not an escape hatch from budgets.

extracted_packages.notes: Runtime code moved to sibling packages or out of the plugin path must be listed in declared_siblings with metric_id and loc; undeclared extractions fail the gate. Declared sibling LOC is added to the named metric before ratchet checks.

enforcement.pre_1_0: Reject any metric above current_ratchet. Decreases are allowed. release_target is not yet required.
enforcement.release_1_0_0: With --release 1.0.0, every metric must be <= release_target. scripts_sh_loc release_target was recalibrated to 9200 under release_target_allow_raise (issue #392, Sol ultra 2026-07-28).
enforcement.post_1_0: Reject any metric above current_ratchet even when hard_ceiling has headroom. hard_ceiling is an absolute cap; current_ratchet must never exceed hard_ceiling.
enforcement.anti_weaken: Relative to merge-base loc-budget.json: release_target, hard_ceiling, and current_ratchet must not increase; exclude_top_level_dirs must not grow; generated_files.policy must remain counted; extracted_packages.policy must not soften; counting_rules text for each metric_id must not change without an explicit allow.

release_target_allow_raise.notes: Sol ultra 2026-07-28 (#392): original 8000 target assumed ~20–25 runtime scripts; retained ~55 independently tested safety-gate scripts (legal, PII, spend, acceptance, regression, exact-head, deploy, queue, issue-closure). Prompt surface is under half its target; dead commit-artifact removed. Further 1129-line shell cuts before 1.0.0 would require behavior-dense rewrites or counter-gaming. Corrected target 9200 / ceiling 9500; ratchet = observed.
